title: iOS 1.74 (QA) · how iOS shows the IR Photo Type on a work order (the reference for Android) · 4 Nov 2026

segments.step: Start: Work Orders list on iOS 1.74 (QA, EG-ACME, site (s) Wild Goose Brewery)
segments.result: Three work orders will be opened: IR, Cleaning + IR checklist, and a non-IR one

segments.step: Step 1: open "QA-DEMO ZP-5135" (Work Type = Infrared Thermography) › Start Work Order › Details
Step 1: Infrared Thermography work order › Details › CAPTURE SETTINGS
segments.result: iOS shows "IR Photo Type" (FLIR-SEP) as a dropdown

segments.step: Step 2: tap the IR Photo Type value
Step 2: the IR Photo Type dropdown is open
segments.result: Options: FLIR-IND, FLIR-SEP, FLUKE, FOTRIC-SEP, FOTRIC-IND

segments.step: Step 2: same value picked again, nothing changed (stays FLIR-SEP)
Step 3: open "Job - Nov 2, 6:28 PM" (Multiple Services: Cleaning + IR Checklist + Engineering Data) › Start › Details
Step 3: maintenance work order that includes an IR checklist
segments.result: iOS shows the IR Photo Type dropdown here too (FOTRIC-SEP) + the FOTRIC Camera card

segments.step: Step 4: open "Work Order - Nov 3, 5:15 PM" (De-Energized Visual Inspection, no IR) › Start › Details
Step 4: work order with no IR service
segments.result: No IR Photo Type row: iOS shows it only when the work order has IR work

boxes.label: no IR Photo Type (no IR work)
